gate: Every output count and automaticChannels exact against both implementations and independent fixture-derived counts; every active voltage exact f32 bits; all Rust inactive output values zero; every row finite; no tolerances, exclusions, alignment or fitted acceptance
lifecycle: Each row is a fresh graph/class; two Rust frames settle one cable. Adoption, bypass, initialization and callback lifecycle are qualified separately by core tests.
inactive_sdk_output: Raw SDK inactive slots are retained in traces but excluded from voltage parity: Merge writes all sixteen SDK output lanes even with a forced shorter count. Rust inactive slots must be zero.
inactive_input_protocol: Poisoned protocol padding is ignored by both adapters: SDK inactive lanes and Rust inactive poly_constant parameters are zeroed. The public Engine probe does not directly inject poisoned PortFrame padding.
